messages:
Maria Chen: quick sanity check — I ran a set of quantization benches for marlin-70b across h100 / a100 in us-east and eu-west. attached summary has latency/throughput and eval deltas. can folks scan for concerning regressions?
Ajay Patel: will take a look. rough question — were these batched or single-stream? that changes kernel choice suggestions.
Maria Chen: mostly single-stream (max_batch=1) to capture p99 latency. we also did a small batched run (batch=8) for throughput.
Li Wei: quick read: h100 int8 shows ~2.4x token/sec vs fp16, a100 ~1.9x. however int8 BLEU drop ~0.7 points on our translation eval in eu-west.
Sara Thompson: is the BLEU drop consistent across seeds / prompt slices? might be hot prompts hitting attention quant sensitivity.
Li Wei: checked slices: regression concentrated on long-context prompts (>1024 tokens) — looks like kv-cache quantization interaction.
Ajay Patel: kernel recs: for h100 keep the FP8 path for >1024 sessions, INT8 for short contexts to maximize throughput. fallback policy: hot-route long-context => fp8-kernel, otherwise int8-kernel.
Maria Chen: noted. any perf cost for that dynamic routing?
Ajay Patel: negligible at routing layer. the real cost is capacity planning — fp8 uses more memory so effective concurrent requests per GPU drops ~12% on h100.
Li Wei: also saw that a100 INT8 warmup penalties are higher — cold kv-cache fill time adds ~30ms. include a 200ms warmup buffer in latency SLO for a100 int8.
quant-bot: bench-run complete: artifact=https://artifacts.redwood.dev/runs/1976543210; summary csv and per-region plots uploaded. (auto)
Sara Thompson: thanks. Maria — can you confirm eval set? we used 2k mixed-domain prompts (translation + summarization + QA). metrics: BLEU / BERTScore / exact_match.
Maria Chen: confirmed. exact numbers: BLEU delta int8 vs fp16: us-east h100 -0.6, eu-west a100 -0.9; BERTScore drop under 0.01 absolute.
Ajay Patel: those BLEU hits are small but not negligible. propose we mark int8 as "preferred" for non-critical ranks and keep fp8 as default for canary rollouts of production traffic.
Li Wei: also adding kernel note: try the new matmul-fusion v2 kernel on a100 — it recovers ~0.2 BLEU on our test in eu-west in lab. need a safety eval before prod.
Maria Chen: action items: (1) Ajay to draft routing policy + capacity delta numbers; (2) Li to run matmul-fusion v2 canary on eu-west a100 small cohort; (3) Sara to add long-context prompts to regression monitor. I'll pin the artifact and open a tiny eval PR. :thumbsup:
Sara Thompson: acked. I'll add the alert thresholds (BLEU drop >0.5 or BERTScore >0.02) and wire to Optimize.
Maria Chen: thanks team, good triage.
